title: "MC-2 partial-pressure suit (seen on pilot Francis Gary Powers)" beside U-2 (p. 63)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a pilot in a partial-pressure suit and helmet standing in front of the nose and open canopy of a U-2 aircraft. Captioned "MC-2 partial-pressure suit (seen on pilot Francis Gary Powers)." The text describes the David Clark Company's partially pressurized "spacesuit" and the Firewel pressurized cockpit system.
